scope: Four real production UI presets, save/reopen, unchanged raw atlas RGBA and metadata, mixed outfit PNGs, and five actions in both directions after closing the editor. No new artwork or visual acceptance is claimed.
limits: Functional capture, not a performance benchmark. Frame observations report missed positions and scheduling gaps rather than assuming every display refresh was observed.

benchmarkRevisitAudit.method: Examines every recorded Resource Timing entry against every catalog asset path, independently of the benchmark's expected-transfer subset.

provenanceAudit.commitAtCaptureMeaning: Repository HEAD when capture began; the production build included the performance changes in the working tree and was NOT built from the unmodified baseline HEAD.
provenanceAudit.productionBuildIdentity: buildFiles records SHA256 of every production JS/CSS/HTML file; the harness rechecked this exact inventory after all browser capture completed.
provenanceAudit.auditScope: Post-capture source audit against the now-committed runtime. The runtime owner kept these source files unchanged during capture; this annotation does not change observations, downloads, or measured times.
